instruction: Generate a BPMN 2.0 diagram: after sending a quote to a customer, wait for their reply. If a reply arrives, record the response; if no reply arrives within five days, cancel the quote.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.intelligence.assistant/generated">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_quote" isExecutable="false" name="Quote follow-up">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Quote ready">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="t1" name="Send quote to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="eg" name="Await reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="e1" name="Reply received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="e2" name="5 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="t2" name="Record response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="t3" name="Cancel quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end1" name="Response recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end2" name="Quote cancelled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="t1"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="loop" name="Request further information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="t2" name="Assess affordability">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>

        <dc:Bounds x="310" y="100" width="100" height="80"/>

instruction: Generate a BPMN 2.0 diagram for a invoice processing process: scan invoice (a manual task), invoke a reusable sub-process via a call activity, throw a message event to notify stakeholders, then post to ledger.

nodes.name: Run match to purchase order sub-process

output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.intelligence.assistant/generated">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_invoice_misc" isExecutable="false" name="Invoice processing">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Invoice received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="t1" name="Scan invoice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="t2" name="Run match to purchase order sub-process">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="thr" name="Notify stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="t3" name="Post to ledger">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Invoice archived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="t1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="t1" targetRef="t2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="t2" targetRef="thr"/>

instruction: Model a customer onboarding (kyc) process in BPMN 2.0 where, after collect identity documents, the process branches on 'Identity verified?': one path activate account, the other refer to manual review.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.intelligence.assistant/generated">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_kyc_xor" isExecutable="false" name="Customer onboarding (KYC)">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Onboarding started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="t1" name="Collect identity documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="g1" name="Identity verified?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="a" name="Activate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="b" name="Refer to manual review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="g2" name="Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Onboarding complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="t1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="t1" targetRef="g1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="g1" targetRef="a" name="open">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">verified == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="g1" targetRef="b" name="review">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">verified == false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
